meaning_en: Feeling fear; scared of something.
example_en: She is afraid of spiders.

meaning_en: Feeling fear about something.

meaning_en: to share the same idea or belief
example_en: We both agree on the plan.

meaning_en: To say sorry about a reason or action.
example_en: He apologised for being late.

meaning_en: To request something.
example_en: I will ask for a glass of water.

meaning_en: Now; right now.

meaning_en: Knowing about something.

meaning_en: Not good at doing something.

meaning_en: Be familiar with something, so it feels normal.

meaning_en: To be owned by someone.

meaning_en: Without planning; accidentally.

meaning_en: Using your hands, not a machine.

meaning_en: Accidentally; because of an error.

meaning_en: To reach a total amount.

meaning_en: To give all your attention to one thing.
example_en: Please concentrate on your homework.

meaning_en: To be controlled or decided by something else.

meaning_en: Pleased with something.

meaning_en: Operating a company or trade.

meaning_en: Wanting to know or learn about something.

meaning_en: To hear and pay attention to.

meaning_en: take care of someone or something.

meaning_en: direct your eyes towards something.

meaning_en: try to find something or someone.

meaning_en: On a ship, train, or aircraft.

meaning_en: Traveling for work, not for pleasure.

meaning_en: Shown for people to see.

meaning_en: Burning; covered in flames.

meaning_en: Intentionally; not by accident.

meaning_en: Talking using a telephone.

meaning_en: Punctually; at the correct time.

meaning_en: bored with something; no longer interested.
